title: Evaluation case z1-scheduling: two people arrange a call about the roll-out
scenario: Two people arrange a call about the roll-out.

events.title: Call tomorrow
events.text: Hi, could we move tomorrow's call about the Teams roll-out to 15:00? The training team has a clash in the morning.

events.title: Re: Call tomorrow
events.text: Sure, 15:00 works for me. I will send a new invitation now.

events.title: Re: Call tomorrow
events.text: Thanks. Could you also send the agenda beforehand?

events.title: Re: Call tomorrow
events.text: The agenda is attached: roll-out plan, training dates and the list of support contacts.
